name: Alterac Granite
summary: Across the mountains of northern Lordaeron, Alterac Granite is quarried near Darrow Hill in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Its resilience and grain draw master stonecutters, and King Magni Bronzebeard's royal mason insists on it for a tribute to fallen soldiers.

sections.title: Stone of Memorials
sections.body: King Magni Bronzebeard ordered a monument for Sully Balloo, a brave dwarven defender who perished in the tragedy at the Thandol Span. Grand Mason Marblesten, charged with sculpting it in Ironforge, insisted on Alterac Granite instead of ordinary quarry stone. Across the Eastern Kingdoms, few stones are finer. Its legendary durability ensures the likeness and memory of a fallen hero endure untarnished for generations.

sections.title: Quarried in Peril
sections.body: Alterac Granite lies around Darrow Hill in the northern Hillsbrad Foothills, near the ruined territories of Alterac. Hostile wildlife, syndicate brigands, and lingering strife make the journey perilous. Bold adventurers must venture deep into contested lands to retrieve unblemished slabs for Ironforge's artisans.

faq.q: What is Alterac Granite used for?
faq.answer: Grand Mason Marblesten in Ironforge requested Alterac Granite for a royal memorial to Sully Balloo, the dwarven soldier who fell defending the Thandol Span.

faq.q: Where can Alterac Granite be found?
faq.answer: Alterac Granite is gathered from deposits at Darrow Hill in the northern Hillsbrad Foothills, near the border of Alterac.

faq.q: Why did Grand Mason Marblesten specifically want this stone?
faq.answer: Grand Mason Marblesten regards Alterac Granite as one of the finest and most resilient carving stones available, worthy of the lasting royal monument King Magni commissioned.
Sully Balloo was a dwarven soldier who died during the fighting at the Thandol Span. King Magni Bronzebeard commissioned a monument to honor his sacrifice for the Alliance.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know why dwarven stonemasons prize quality: this robust mountain stone is essential for honoring a fellow son of Ironforge.
As a miner or prospector, you can appreciate Alterac Granite for its clean fracture and extraordinary density, qualities that set it apart from common crag rock.
